Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values against human single-protein target CHEMBL4282. Filter to target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, and standard_relation '='. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
